# Fixtures from VisuaLex

Copied from [VisuaLexAPI](https://github.com/capazme/VisuaLexAPI) (MPL-2.0), which
stays their source: a change is made there first and copied here.

| File | VisuaLex path | Read at | Pinned by |
|---|---|---|---|
| `golden.json` | `conventions/sources/golden.json` | `eca698dc` (last changed in `65ee1aa7`) | `tests/unit/test_visualex_golden.py` (sha256) |

`golden.json` is VisuaLex's convention for legal sources: who a norm or a
decision is, and how it is written. mcp-legal-it asserts the identities it
already builds the same way and lists, by id, the ones it does not yet.
